# Parity Fix Review

Lightweight post-fix review gate for shard-level parity fixes.

## Parity Correctness (Blocking)

1. Every Java branch has a corresponding Rust branch
2. Every Java null check maps to Rust `Option` handling
3. Output-affecting maps use `IndexMap` where Java uses `LinkedHashMap`
4. Float formatting matches Java `DecimalFormat` exactly
5. Integer overflow uses `wrapping_*` where Java would silently overflow

## Regression Test Verification (Blocking)

- One new `#[test]` function exists following the naming convention from `rust-parity.instructions.md`: `test_target_bam_{bam_slug}_{chr}_{description}_parity` or `test_{module}_{description}_parity`
- The test compares Rust output against a **Java-generated fixture** (not Rust output). Verify the fixture source — if the expected output was generated by Rust, this check **fails**.
- The test reproduces the original failure scenario
- `cargo test --profile debug-release -- --include-ignored` passes

## Performance Gate (Conditional)

- Check if the fix touches a hot-path module (CigarParser, VariationRealigner, StructuralVariantsProcessor, ToVarsBuilder, pipeline, VecMap/InnerMap)
- If YES -> load `change-impact-review` skill in Self-Assessment Mode, include verdict
- If NO -> record `PERF_SAFE (cold path, skipped)`

## Output Format

```markdown
## Fix Review: {module/function}
**Verdict**: FIX_APPROVED / FIX_BLOCKED
**Parity Correctness**: {PASS / items failed}
**Regression Test**: {test name} — {PASS / MISSING}
**Performance**: {PERF_SAFE / advisory verdict from change-impact-review}
**Blocking Issues**: {list or "none"}
```

## Constraints

This is NOT a full code review. Do not evaluate idiomatic Rust style or extensibility. Those belong in the full code-reviewer pass.
